title: checkout-service — Operational Runbook
body: checkout-service renders the cart and checkout flow and calls payments-service to authorize and capture payment. Common incidents: elevated checkout abandonment (check payments-service latency first — it's the most common root cause), cart pricing mismatches (check the pricing-cache TTL), and inventory oversell (check the inventory-service webhook queue). Owned by the Commerce team; page the Commerce on-call for checkout-specific issues and the Engineering on-call rotation for anything that traces back to payments-service.
